subject: API key rejection and integration guidance
body:
Hello,

I'm hoping you can help with two things that have come up. On our side, when we try to use our API key for the payments endpoint, it gets rejected with an authentication error. We've checked the key format and it looks correct, but it still fails. At the same time, we're trying to figure out how to properly integrate the refunds feature. The documentation seems a bit unclear on the required headers and the correct sequence of calls. We've read through the API docs and some forum posts, but we're still not sure about the best practice for handling partial refunds.

Just to give you some context, the payment involved is about 242,385.50 euros. We have a workaround in place for now, so our operations are continuing, but we'd like to get this sorted out properly.

Could you please advise on both the key rejection issue and the correct way to implement the refunds integration? We'd appreciate any guidance or pointers to relevant documentation.

Thanks,

Alex Mercer
Operations Manager
Northwind Retail Group

Could someone from your technical team take a proper look and get back to me?

Thanks,
Daniel

subject: Virement attendu non reçu et introuvable, malgré nos relances
body:
Bonjour,

Je vous écris car un virement que nous attendions n'est jamais arrivé sur notre compte, et il est introuvable. Cela fait maintenant plusieurs jours que nous surveillons nos relevés, et rien. C'est extrêmement frustrant, d'autant plus que nous vous avons déjà contactés à ce sujet sans obtenir de réponse claire.

Pour être précis : la transaction a bien été initiée de notre côté, mais l'argent n'a jamais été crédité. Nous avons vérifié auprès de notre banque, qui ne voit aucun mouvement entrant correspondant. De votre côté, on nous dit que le paiement a été traité, mais sans jamais nous fournir de preuve tangible. Cette situation est inacceptable pour nous, car elle perturbe notre gestion quotidienne et nos prévisions de trésorerie.

Heureusement, nous avons pu continuer à fonctionner grâce à un contournement temporaire, mais cela ne peut pas durer. Nous avons besoin que vous fassiez la lumière sur ce qui s'est passé et que vous nous disiez où se trouve cet argent. Merci de nous répondre rapidement avec des explications concrètes.

Cordialement,
Camille

subject: Consulta sobre acceso a la API y un cargo en el estado de cuenta
body:
Hola,

Escribo desde el área de operaciones de una empresa de logística. Tenemos dos temas que quisieramos revisar con ustedes, ninguno más importante que el otro.

Por un lado, desde ayer nuestro equipo no puede conectarse a la API: la clave que usamos habitualmente es rechazada al intentar autenticar. Seguimos operando con el panel web como respaldo, por lo que las operaciones continuan con normalidad, pero nos gustaría saber si hubo algún cambio en las credenciales o si deben regenerar el acceso.

Por otro lado, en el estado de cuenta aparece un cargo por una comisión que nunca acordamos. La transacción asociada es TX-482066 y quisiéramos que la revisen y, si corresponde, la reviertan. No reconocemos ese concepto en nuestro contrato.

Quedamos atentos a sus comentarios sobre ambos puntos. Gracias por su atención.

Saludos cordiales,
Marta

body:
Hello,

I run a small guesthouse and I need to raise a problem with a payment that was supposed to reach us through Keelpay. The transaction reference is TX-885440. The payment was expected some time ago, but it never arrived, and when I check our account I cannot find it anywhere. There is no trace of it on our side at all.

I have gone through our records more than once and asked our bookkeeper to double-check as well, and we both come to the same conclusion: the money is simply not there. This is not the first time we have had to chase something like this, and frankly it is frustrating to keep spending time on a payment that should have landed without any fuss.

For now we are managing. We have been able to keep the guesthouse running by using other funds to cover the bills that this payment was meant for, so nothing has ground to a halt, but it is an ongoing headache and it is putting a strain on our cash flow. I would like you to look into TX-885440 and tell me what has happened to it.

Please treat this as a firm complaint and come back to me with an explanation and a clear picture of where this payment is.

Regards,
Daniel

subject: How to set up the payouts API for our retail stores
body:
Hi Keelpay Support,

I'm the developer at a small retail chain and I'm trying to figure out how to integrate your payouts feature into our internal system, but the docs I found are pretty thin on the actual setup steps and I've read through them a couple of times now with no luck. To be fair we do have an ongoing issue where our current payout process is manual and it's causing us extra work every week, though operations are still moving along with the workaround we put together so nothing has stopped. What I need is guidance on the correct way to authenticate and structure the payout calls, and any best practice you'd recommend for handling retries and reconciling batches on our side. I've checked the API reference but it doesnt really explain the flow end to end, and the sample code seems to skip a few steps that I can't quite piece together. Could someone point me to the right guide or walk me through the recommended approach? I'd rather get this right the first time instead of guessing and rebuilding later. Thanks for your help.

Best regards,
Marcus

subject: Contestation de paiement par carte – TX-828632
body:
Bonjour,

Je vous écris car nous avons reçu un avis de litige de la part d'un porteur de carte concernant la transaction TX-828632 d'un montant de 1476.20 €, et franchement je trouve ca inadmissible que ce genre de chose arrive encore sans qu'on soit prévenu correctement en amont. Nous avons fourni la prestation logicielle complète, l'accès a été activé et utilisé par le client pendant plusieurs semaines, donc contester ce paiement n'a aucun sens, et je suis assez remonté par la facon dont ce dossier est traité. Cela dit, nos opérations continuent normalement de notre coté, on a mis en place un suivi manuel des encaissements en attendant que la situation se décante, donc rien n'est bloqué. J'ai rassemblé les preuves d'utilisation et les échanges avec le client, que je peux vous transmettre rapidement si vous me confirmez la marche à suivre pour contester ce litige. J'aimerais surtout comprendre pourquoi nous n'avons pas été informés plus tot et quels sont les delais habituels de traitement, car ce n'est pas la premiere fois que ce genre de désagrément nous tombe dessus. Merci de me dire ce qu'il vous faut de plus pour défendre ce dossier.

Thanks,
Dana

subject: Card chargeback notice on TX-862932 — our account activity is blocked
body:
Hello,

I am the accountant at an education provider that uses your platform for our card payments. We have received a cardholder dispute notice for the transaction reference TX-862932, for the amount of 60.20. I am writing to respond to that notice, as we believe this charge was valid and we have the supporting records to show it.

Since this chargeback came through, our business activity is blocked. We cannot process the payments we depend on to keep our enrolment and tuition operations running, and this is already causing real disruption to our work with students and families.

Please treat this as a formal escalation. If our activity is not restored and this dispute is not resolved properly, we will move our payment processing to another provider. We would much rather stay, but we cannot operate while we are locked out.

Regards,
Priya

subject: Question sur PSD2 / authentification forte — dossier TX-20-9041
body:
Bonjour,

Je transfère ci-dessous l'échange que j'ai eu avec votre support, parce que là je commence vraiment à perdre patience : ça fait trois fois qu'on me renvoie la même réponse toute faite sans jamais répondre à ma vraie question. Je suis propriétaire d'une petite boutique et je travaille dans la logistique, donc je ne suis pas expert en réglementation bancaire, et j'ai besoin qu'on m'explique clairement ce que la PSD2 et l'authentification forte changent pour mes encaissements, et surtout ce qui relève de l'anti-blanchiment dans mon cas. Est-ce que ces règles s'appliquent à moi de la même façon qu'à un grossiste, ou est-ce qu'il y a des exceptions pour les petits volumes ? Ma référence de transaction est TX-20-9041 et j'aimerai bien qu'on me réponde précisément à ce sujet, pas par un copier-coller générique. Je ne suis pas pressé par le temps, mais j'aimerais comprendre, parce que personne n'a été foutu de m'expliquer ça correctement jusqu'ici.

Merci de me répondre par écrit, clairement, cette fois.

Cordialement,
Julien

> Le 12 mars, support Keelpay a écrit :
> Bonjour,
> Merci pour votre message. Les règles PSD2 et les obligations de lutte contre le blanchiment dépendent de votre profil et de votre activité. Nous vous invitons à consulter la documentation disponible dans votre espace client. Pour toute question complémentaire, n'hésitez pas à revenir vers nous.
> Bien cordialement,
> L'équipe support

body:
Hi Keelpay Support,

I'm the accountant at a small education provider, and for the past several days our integration with your platform has been rejecting our API key or login outright, so we cannot reconcile or process anything programmatically. We've managed to keep operations going by entering everything manually into your dashboard, which is why I haven't written sooner, but this is a real, ongoing problem and it is costing my team hours every single day. I've already reset the credentials once and confirmed we're using the correct environment, and the rejection persists, so this is clearly something on your side. I need someone from your technical team to actually investigate this and tell me what is wrong, not just send me another article about regenerating keys. If this isn't resolved properly, I will be raising it with your account management team and seriously reconsidering whether we stay with Keelpay, because a payments provider whose basic authentication doesn't work is not one we can rely on. Please treat this as a formal complaint and confirm who is taking ownership of it.

Regards,
Priya

I'm writing as the founder of a retail company that relies on your payment notification webhooks to keep our order processing in sync, and for the past two days those webhooks are no longer being delivered to our endpoint—it just fails silently. We're currently manually checking the dashboard and reconciling payments by hand, which is keeping operations running but is not sustainable, and if this isn't resolved soon we will be forced to escalate this to your management team and seriously reconsider our relationship with Keelpay. I need someone from your technical team to investigate and fix this immediately. Please treat this as a top priority and get back to me with a concrete plan.

Best regards,
Alex

body:
Hi there,

I’m the compliance officer for a retail group that has been evaluating your payment platform for several weeks now, and I’m frankly fed up with how opaque your pricing is. Every time I ask for a straightforward commercial offer, I get vague answers, links to generic pages, or a request to talk to sales, which never actually happens. I don’t have a problem to solve—I just want to understand your fees, what’s included, and whether you offer any volume-based terms for a retail business like ours. It shouldn’t be this hard to get basic numbers from a company that claims to be transparent.

Can you please send me a clear, written commercial offer that I can review with my team? I’m not in a rush, but I do expect a real answer this time.

Thanks,
Alex

Hi,

I'm writing about a charge on our latest Keelpay statement that we never signed off on. It's listed at 63 CHF and it's tied to what looks like a monthly platform fee we didn't agree to when we set up the account. I've gone back through our onboarding paperwork and our emails with your team, and there's nothing that authorizes this. I'm a dev on the retail side, so I deal with integrations and billing configs all day, and this one just isn't in any of our records.

For context, our order pipeline is still running fine — we've routed everything through a manual fallback we built a while back, so nothing is fully down on our end. But this fee is still sitting there and it keeps showing up, which means somebody on your side has it flagged as active. I've already filed it under ORD-978468 on our internal tracker so it doesnt get lost while we sort this out.

Can you look into where this 63 CHF came from and get it reversed? I'd also like to know who approved it, because as far as I can tell nobody did. I'm not looking to escalate this any further right now, but I do want a straight answer rather than another automated reply.

Thanks,
Marta

Our payment notification webhooks have stopped being delivered. We are a retail business and rely on those notifications to reconcile every transaction. Since yesterday, nothing is arriving at our endpoint, and we have no way of knowing if payments are coming through. This is completely unacceptable.

To make matters worse, our funds are frozen. We cannot access any of the money that should be in our account. I have been trying to get someone on the phone for hours and all I get is a runaround. This is no way to treat a paying customer.

Fix this now. Unfreeze our account and restore the webhooks. I want an explanation for why this happened in the first place.

On Monday, our developer wrote:
> I checked the endpoint and the logs show no incoming requests from Keelpay since yesterday morning. The server is up and responding normally to other traffic, so the issue is on your side. Please confirm if there were any recent changes to your webhook configuration or if our account is under some kind of restriction.

subject: Question about PSD2 and Strong Customer Authentication for my travel shop
body:
Dear Keelpay Support,

I am the owner of a small travel shop and I would like to clarify a few points about the PSD2 and strong customer authentication rules that apply to my business. My understanding is that these rules are intended to make electronic payments more secure, but I am not sure how they affect the way I take payments from customers. I would appreciate it if you could explain, in simple terms, what strong customer authentication means for a merchant like me. I also have a question about anti-money-laundering rules and what basic checks I might need to be aware of. I am asking purely for information, as I want to make sure my business stays compliant. Thank you for your time and for any guidance you can provide.

Best regards,
Laura

body:
Bon, ça fait trois jours que nos appels à votre API partent en vrille. On reçoit des 500 à la pelle, parfois des 504 après trente secondes d'attente, et certaines requêtes échouent carrément sans code retour. On a relancé, changé de clé, rien n'y fait. Là je passe mes journées à surveiller les logs au lieu de coder, c'est pas mon boulot.

Le pire c'est le timing. On doit boucler la mise en conformité pour la rentrée, il y a une échéance réglementaire fixe et si l'intégration ne tient pas debout on ne pourra pas livrer dans les temps. Je ne peux pas me permettre d'expliquer à mon établissement qu'on rate la date parce que vos serveurs répondent quand ils en ont envie.

J'ai ouvert un ticket chez vous il y a deux jours, toujours aucune réponse sérieuse, juste un accusé automatique. J'aimerais qu'un vrai ingénieur regarde ça et nous dise ce qui se passe côté passerelle, parce que de notre côté tout est propre. On est coincés, et plus le temps passe, plus ça devient intenable.

Bonjour l'équipe Keelpay,

Je developpe une petite plateforme de reservation pour des hotels independants et je cherche a mieux comprendre comment les regles PSD2 et l'authentification forte du client (SCA) s'appliquent quand un etablissement encaisse un client qui n'est pas physiquement present, par exemple pour un accompte de sejour. Est-ce que la DSP2 impose des exceptions pour les paiements recurrents ou pour les transactions dites « marchand-initiated » dans le secteur de l'hotellerie ? Je me demandais aussi comment vos equipes reconcillient ces exigences avec les obligations anti-blanchiment, surtout pour les clients etrangers qui paient depuis un pays different de celui de l'hotel. Franchement, votre documentation et votre support ont ete d'une clarté rare quand j'ai integre vos API, et ca m'a vraiment fait gagner du temps sur ce projet, donc merci beaucoup pour ca. Si vous avez un guide ou un webinaire la-dessus, je suis preneur, sans aucun pressé de mon cote. Merci d'avance pour vos lumieres.

Bien a vous,
Camille

subject: Payment notification webhooks not delivered – endpoint failing
body:
Hello Keelpay Support,

We are a SaaS company and rely on your payment notification webhooks to update our billing system. Since yesterday afternoon, our endpoint is no longer recieving any delivery attempts from Keelpay. We have checked our server logs and firewall rules, and no inbound requests from your platform are visible. The endpoint responds correctly to manual tests, so the issue appears to be on the sending side. This is currently blocking our business activity, as we cannot process new subscriptions or renewals. Could you please investigate whether webhook delivery has been paused or if our endpoint URL has been marked as failing? We would appreciate a quick update on what you find.

Thanks,
Alex

subject: Guidance on integrating the payouts API for our marketplace sellers
body:
Hello Keelpay team,

I'm a developer at an online marketplace, and we're getting ready to add automated payouts for our sellers using your API. Before we build it out, I'd like some guidance on the best way to integrate and use this feature — the recommended setup flow, the key endpoints, and any good practices around idempotency and retries that you'd suggest for a marketplace with many sellers and frequent payout runs.

If there's documentation or a sample integration you can point me to, that would be a great starting point. We're not blocked: our finance team currently triggers payouts manually through the dashboard, so operations are continuing as usual while we work on this. I just want to make sure we build the integration the right way from the start rather than guessing at the details.

I also want to say that your support and engineering teams have been genuinely excellent to work with — responsive, clear, and patient with our questions, which is rare in this space and makes a real difference for a small team like ours.

Thanks for any pointers you can share.

Best regards,
Daniel

En même temps je me pose des questions sur la PSD2 et l'authentification forte du client, parce que je vois des prélèvements de 92 € qui passent parfois sans validation, et je ne sais pas si c'est normal ou si c'est un problème de conformité. Franchement, si je n'ai pas de réponse claire et rapide, je passe à un autre prestataire et je remonte le sujet à qui de droit. Je veux justement savoir si cette histoire relève de la lutte contre le blanchiment ou juste d'une vérification d'identité classique. Merci de me dire ce qu'il en est, parce que là je suis prêt à partir.

subject: Quick question about my account
body:
Hi,

I'm getting pretty fed up with how things have been going on my account lately. I was expecting a payment from a customer and it never showed up in my account at all — I've gone back through everything and I just can't find it anywhere. On top of that, the amount that did come through doesnt match what I was expecting, it was about 28.20 euros but that's not what I calculated at all. Both of these are really frustrating to deal with as a small shop.

Can someone please look into where the missing payment went, and also explain why the amount was off? I'm still managing to keep the shop running in the meantime by covering things myself, but I'd like both of these sorted out properly. It feels like I'm chasing you lot for answers every time.

Thanks,
Marta

subject: API key rejected and regulatory filing deadline
body: Our API key for the Keelpay integration is being rejected when we attempt to authenticate, and our team has not been able to resolve this on our end. We first noticed the rejections this morning while processing routine payment operations for our property. Our compliance obligations require that we submit payment records to the regulator by the end of this week, and the rejected key is blocking the export we rely on for that filing. Could you please confirm whether the key has been disabled or rotated, and advise on the steps to restore access? If a new key or token is required, we would appreciate the details so we can update our systems. Please let us know if you need any information from us to look into this. Thank you for your help. — Priya

subject: Two issues: unrecognized fee and missing payment webhooks
body:
Dear Keelpay Support,

I hope this finds you well. First, I want to say how much I appreciate the support team—every time I've reached out, you've been patient, knowledgeable, and genuinely helpful. That kind of service makes a real difference for a small logistics shop like mine.

I'm writing about two separate matters that I'd like your help with. First, I noticed a fee on my statement for 43807.90 euros that I never agreed to. I've reviewed my contract and previous statements, and I can't find any basis for this charge. I'd like you to investigate and reverse it, or explain exactly what it's for if I'm mistaken.

Second, my payment notification webhooks have stopped being delivered. My endpoint is up and responding, but I'm not receiving any callbacks for recent transactions. I've checked my server logs and confirmed there are no errors on my side. Could you look into whether there's an issue with the webhook delivery system or my configuration? This isn't blocking our operations—we have a manual workaround—but it's adding extra steps and I'd like to get it resolved.

Thanks again for your help. I look forward to hearing from you on both points.

Best regards,
Alex

subject: Richiesta di accesso ai dati personali ai sensi del GDPR
body:
Salve,

scrivo in qualità di responsabile della conformità di un'azienda del settore retail. Sono francamente esasperato dal fatto che, nonostante le diverse richieste già inviate, non abbia ancora ricevuto alcun riscontro in merito al trattamento dei dati personali che ci riguardano.

Con la presente formulo una richiesta di accesso ai sensi del GDPR: desidero sapere quali dati personali associate alla nostra azienda e ai suoi referenti state trattando, per quali finalità, a chi vengono comunicati e per quanto tempo vengono conservati. Vorrei inoltre ricevere copia dei dati stessi in un formato leggibile. Vi ricordo che il pagamento oggetto della transazione TX-197612, pari a 7,042 euros, è stato regolarmente eseguito e non vedo alcun motivo per cui la nostra situazione debba restare poco chiara.

Preciso che questa comunicazione è di carattere puramente informativo e non richiede alcuna azione immediata da parte vostra. Resto in attesa di una risposta scritta e completa.

Distinti saluti,
Giulia

Pourriez-vous vérifier l'état de notre clé et me dire ce qu'il convient de faire ?

Merci d'avance,
Camille

Dear Keelpay Support,

I am writing on behalf of our travel operations team regarding a payment we expected to receive and which has not appeared in our account. Our records show the entry 899228 on our side, but no corresponding funds have been credited. I have checked our account history and asked our finance colleague to review the relevant statements, and neither of us can locate the payment. As we operate in the travel sector, we are required to reconcile all incoming payments before a regulatory reporting deadline that applies to our business. Could you please confirm whether the payment was processed and, if so, where it was sent? If any further details are needed from us to trace it, I will provide them promptly. Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards,
Daniel

Cordialement,
Camille

subject: Question about PSD2 / strong customer authentication for our marketplace
body:
Hello,

I’m the compliance officer at an online marketplace, and we’ve been reviewing our payment flows in light of PSD2 and the strong customer authentication requirements, as well as how anti-money-laundering rules apply to the types of transactions we process. Your team has been exceptionally clear and responsive whenever we’ve had questions in the past, and that has made a real difference in helping us keep our own compliance work on track. Could you point me to any guidance you have on when SCA is required for merchant-initiated transactions versus customer-initiated ones, and whether there are any exemptions that commonly apply to marketplaces like ours? I’d also like to understand how the AML expectations differ for platforms that facilitate payments between buyers and sellers, especially around ongoing monitoring. For context, our internal review is tied to case 339515, though I’m only asking for general information at this stage. There’s no rush and no impact on our current operations—I’m just trying to make sure we’re thinking about this correctly. Any documentation or a short explanation would be very helpful.

Thanks,
Priya

Bonjour, je travaille comme responsable des opérations dans une entreprise de logiciel en tant que service et je me pose une question sur les règles PSD2 et l'authentification forte du client. Nous utilisons Keelpay pour nos encaissements et je souhaite mieux comprendre comment ces exigences s'appliquent à nos clients professionnels en Europe.

Plus précisément, je voudrais savoir si l'authentification forte du client est requise pour tous les paiements B2B ou s'il existe des exemptions pour certains types de transactions récurrentes. Je cherche aussi à comprendre le lien entre ces règles et les obligations de lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent, notamment en matière de vérification d'identité.

Nous voulons simplement nous assurer que nos propres processus internes sont alignés avec ce que Keelpay attend de nous. Si vous avez un guide ou une page de documentation à nous indiquer, cela nous aiderait à orienter nos équipes.

Merci d'avance pour votre retour.

Camille

Je vous écris car en consultant notre relever de compte nous avons constater qu'un frais de 1670.50 nous a été prélevé alors que nous n'avons jamais valider ce montant ni signer quoi que ce soit pour l'autoriser. Nous sommes un commerce de détail et ce genre de prélèvement non convenu perturbe gravement notre trésorerie, surtout que notre comptable ne retrouve aucune trace d'un accord de notre part. Je vous demande donc de bien vouloir annuler ce frais et de nous rembourser sous 48 heures, sans quoi nous serons dans l'obligation de suspendre nos prélèvements et de faire remonter le dossier à notre direction juridique. Si rien n'est fait d'ici là, nous envisagerons sérieusement de passer chez un autre prestataire, car nous ne pouvons pas travailler avec un partenaire qui applique des frais sans accord préalable. J'attends une confirmation écrite de votre part rapidement.

Cordialement,
Camille

subject: Question about PSD2 and strong customer authentication
body:
Hi Keelpay team,

I build and maintain the payment flows for an online marketplace, and I've been consistently impressed by how clear and reliable your platform has been for our team — it's genuinely made a difference in how smoothly we can operate. I wanted to ask a question about PSD2, strong customer authentication, or anti-money-laundering rules.

Could you point me to any guidance you have on how these requirements apply to a marketplace like ours, particularly around when strong customer authentication is triggered and what we should keep in mind for anti-money-laundering compliance? I'm trying to build a clearer picture for our internal documentation, and I'd appreciate any direction you can offer.

No rush at all — this is purely so I can understand the landscape better. Thanks again for the support you and the team provide.

Best regards,
Daniel
Developer, Northbridge Marketplace

Forwarding this on because I want it on record before we decide what to do about our account.

We were charged 28 126,20 on tx-530099 and I have no idea where this came from. I never agreed to it. Nobody on our side signed off on it, and I don't recognise it from any of the terms we discussed. I've asked our finance lead to comb through the paperwork and she can't find anything either, so as far as I'm concerned this is a charge that was never authorised.

In the meantime we're still shipping and paying suppliers, so the business is running, but our accounts person is now manually reconciling every line on the statement before anything goes out, which is eating a day a week. That's not sustainable. If we can't get a straight answer on who agreed to this and why it's on our statement, I'll be escalating it formally and seriously reconsidering whether we keep processing through you at all.

Best,
Marcus
Founder, Bellhaven Retail

subject: API errors and timeouts when calling the payments endpoint
body:
Hello,

We have been seeing errors when calling the API from our side. Some calls return HTTP 500, and a few others time out before a response comes back. This has been happening on and off since Monday.

We can still process what we need to by retrying the calls manually, so operations are continuing as normal for now. One of the affected payments is transaction reference "TX-748546", and our payments are in "EUR".

I am forwarding the exchange below for the details.

Thanks,
Marta

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Marta
Sent: Tuesday, 11 March
To: Keelpay support
Subject: API errors

Hello, just to add the details here. When we send a request we sometimes get HTTP 500 back, and other times the connection just times out with no response. This happens across a few different calls, not one specific one. We have tried retrying and it works on the second or third attempt. I do not have a pattern yet for when it fails. Please let me know if you need anything else from our side.

body:

Je vous demande donc de bien vouloir examiner cette transaction et de nous indiquer la marche à suivre pour régulariser l'écart. Dans l'attente de votre retour, je reste à votre disposition pour tout complément d'information.

Cordialement,
Camille

body:
Bonjour,

Je vous écris pour contester fermement des frais de 108,99 € qui figurent sur mon relevé et que je n'ai jamais acceptés. Cordialement,
Julien
